description: Manufacturing Authority Packs (spec §1.2, §15.2). Each entry names a pack file on disk and its SHA-256 digest over the raw file bytes. The pack loader validates every digest on load; a mismatch is a pack-governance failure and the loader raises rather than serving possibly-tampered rules.
